description: This file defines the class IPTestAdministrator, which manages inter-process testing synchronization, including process forking, message exchange, and process coordination using pthread synchronization primitives.

classes.name: IPTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that manages inter-process test synchronization, process forking, message passing, and process coordination.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test administrator with a callback and optional wait time.

methods.name: ForkChildProcess
methods.description: Method to fork a child process and start the test process.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the test processes with a message string.

methods.name: WaitForChildCompletion
methods.description: Waits for the child process to complete.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the user data associated with the test administrator.

methods.name: TimedLock
methods.description: Attempts to lock a mutex with a timeout, logging the provided string.

methods.name: TimedWait
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with a timeout, logging the provided string.

methods.name: FillTimeOut
methods.description: Fills a timespec structure with a timeout value.
